description: Funding rate history for any perpetual-futures pair — up to 2 YEARS of history (17000+ rows for BTCUSDT since 2024-04-08). Bucket via ?interval=1h/4h/8h/1d, look-back via ?days=1..730. Per bucket returns rate, predicted_rate, open_interest, annualized_pct, sample count. Plus stats (min/max/avg/current rate). AI agent API for funding-rate backtesting, carry-trade strategy research, and long-horizon derivatives analysis.
